name: ai-mock
icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 8V4H8"/><rect width="16" height="12" x="4" y="8" rx="2"/><path d="M2 14h2"/><path d="M20 14h2"/></svg>
summary: Deterministic mock AI provider — no network, no spend
description: Scripted completions for ai-core. Installs with the @jpulse-net/plugin-ai-core bundle. Answers without an API key so a fresh install and CI can run a turn. Do not install this plugin separately.
author: jPulse Team <team@jpulse.net>

schema.content: ai-mock never calls a network. Prefix a user message with [mock:text], [mock:tools], [mock:tool:name:{args}], [mock:truncated], [mock:retry], [mock:fatal], [mock:slow], [mock:hang], [mock:throw], or [mock:unpriced] to pick a script. A sequence uses the structured script.steps field.
